description: A battalion S-6 signal officer must publish next week's validation plan for the East and West relay sites, assigning exact test windows and test sets while recording the coordination actions needed to keep the schedule executable.

shared_context.S1: The East and West relay sites each require one network validation next week.
shared_context.S2: The routine proposed windows are Tuesday 0900-1100 for East and Thursday 0900-1100 for West.
shared_context.S3: Test sets TS-4 and TS-7 are held by the communications section, and Maj. Alvarez publishes the final validation plan.
shared_context.S4: Before the plan is published, the S-6 conducts the weekly spectrum-coordination huddle with network control and communications supply for updates to the proposed schedule.

PF1.text: SFC Brooks received a higher-headquarters signal-readiness directive this morning requiring the West relay to be validated first on Tuesday from exactly 0900-1000 and its results reported by 1200; the directive arrived after the morning briefing and has not yet been added to the battalion signal plan.

PF2.text: SSG Patel confirmed with the test-equipment desk that the East relay's encryption module can be validated only with TS-7, and TS-7 is available for that module only on Thursday from exactly 1000-1200; the equipment availability entry is still being posted to the supply tracker.

acceptance_conditions: The West relay must be validated Tuesday from 0900-1000.
The East relay must be validated Thursday from 1000-1200.
TS-4 must be assigned to the West validation.
TS-7 must be assigned to the East validation.
The higher-headquarters West validation directive must be cited as justification.
A commitment to submit the West validation results by 1200 must be recorded.
A commitment to reserve TS-7 for the East validation must be recorded.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'results_submission' and c['target'] == 'West relay' and c['detail'] == 'Submit validation results by 1200 Tuesday' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'test_set_reservation' and c['target'] == 'TS-7' and c['detail'] == 'Reserve for East relay Thursday 1000-1200' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The higher-headquarters directive changes the West relay window from the proposed Thursday 0900-1100 slot to exactly Tuesday 0900-1000 and adds the exact Tuesday 1200 reporting commitment.
The East relay's TS-7-only compatibility and exact Thursday 1000-1200 availability change both its test-set assignment and its validation window and require the TS-7 reservation.
